mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.recipe ( user_id, recipe_category_id, title, description, servings, cooking_time, difficulty, thumbnail_url, like_count, cooked_count, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{recipeCategoryId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{servings}, #{cookingTime}, #{difficulty}, #{thumbnailUrl}, 0, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE public.recipe SET recipe_category_id = #{recipeCategoryId}, title = #{title}, description = #{description}, servings = #{servings}, cooking_time = #{cookingTime}, difficulty = #{difficulty}, thumbnail_url = #{thumbnailUrl}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE recipe_id = #{recipeId}
mapper.select: SELECT r.recipe_id, r.user_id, r.recipe_category_id, r.title, r.description, r.servings, r.cooking_time, r.difficulty, r.thumbnail_url, r.like_count, r.cooked_count, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM public.recipe r WHERE r.recipe_id = #{recipeId}
SELECT rc.recipe_category_id, rc.category_name, rc.display_order, rc.created_at FROM public.recipe_category rc ORDER BY rc.display_order ASC, rc.recipe_category_id ASC
SELECT rc.recipe_category_id, rc.category_name, rc.display_order, rc.created_at FROM public.recipe_category rc WHERE rc.recipe_category_id = #{recipeCategoryId}

SELECT r.recipe_id, r.user_id, r.recipe_category_id, r.title, r.description, r.servings, r.cooking_time, r.difficulty, r.thumbnail_url, r.like_count, r.cooked_count, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM public.recipe r ORDER BY (COALESCE(r.cooked_count, 0) + COALESCE(r.like_count, 0)) DESC, r.created_at DESC, r.recipe_id DESC LIMIT 1
